design.description: Design system — Apple analysis with tokens, typography, components. Source of truth for all visual decisions.

reference-site.description: Reference site content and assets — read for copy, images, and patterns.

website.description: Target build directory for the Aura website.

builder.description: Builds website pages with full read/write access. Translates specs into HTML/CSS/JS.

designer.description: Design-focused review agent. Reads pages and audits against DESIGN.md. Read-only.

reviewer.description: Quality reviewer — audits for accessibility, anti-patterns, and DESIGN.md compliance. Read-only.

utility-fixer.description: Fixes broken layout caused by dead Tailwind-like utility classes. Adds CSS utility layer and verifies rendering.

build-page.description: Run ADW pipeline for a single page: Architect → Developer → Reviewer. Usage: /build-page index|manifesto|docs
build-page.template: Run the ADW pipeline for page $ARGUMENTS (index, manifesto, or docs). Follow DESIGN.md, CONTEXT.md, and AGENTS.md. Plan, build production-ready HTML/CSS/JS into the website directory, then audit and fix compliance issues.

build-all.description: Run full ADW pipeline for all pages. Usage: /build-all
build-all.template: Run the full ADW pipeline for all pages (index, manifesto, docs). Follow DESIGN.md, CONTEXT.md, and AGENTS.md. Build production-ready pages, copy needed assets, audit against DESIGN.md, fix issues, and summarize results.

design-audit.description: Audit the entire site against DESIGN.md. Usage: /design-audit
design-audit.template: Audit the complete website against DESIGN.md. Check colors, typography, layout, shapes, nav, buttons, accessibility, and anti-patterns. Produce a PASS/FAIL report only — do not modify files.

fix-utilities.description: Fix broken layout caused by dead Tailwind-like utility classes. Scans all pages, generates css/utilities.css, links it in all HTML files.
fix-utilities.template: Fix the dead utility class problem. The entire layout uses Tailwind-like classes (flex, grid-cols-3, gap-6, p-8, items-center, md:*) that have no CSS definitions. Scan all 4 HTML files, create a comprehensive css/utilities.css with all missing classes, and link it in every HTML page. Use design tokens from css/global.css. Then remove the empty @media (max-width: 640px) block from style.css. Verify all pages render with proper layout.

harness.description: Run the Google Antigravity harness. Usage: /harness --aura "your prompt" or /harness -r "question"
harness.template:
Run the Google Antigravity harness at D:\PROJECTS\Harness\SDK\agent_harness.py with these arguments: $ARGUMENTS

Examples:
- python agent_harness.py --aura "..."
- python agent_harness.py -r "..."
- python agent_harness.py --show-prompt --aura
